title: Simplification engine first slice vs vulture on unused public functions
summary: orchestrate simplify (subsumed) over src + tests + agent.py reported 3 unused public functions (documents.extract_field_region, capability.load_records, recovery.checkpoint_workflow_record); vulture 2.16 (external, isolated venv) over the same scope at 60% confidence reported the same 3 plus one private helper (watching._slug), which simplify skips by design: 3/3 agreement on public functions. Scanning src alone, vulture reported 23, mostly functions used only by tests, which is why the repository-wide scope matters. Duplicate detection found 2 real structural clone groups (changes vs improvements incremental loaders and getters); a unit test caught over-normalization (erasing attribute names made x.sort() and x.reverse() identical), fixed before the report. Prior-art matching required >= 2 capability-area terms after generic-word matches proved noisy. Whole repo: 103 modules, ~26.2k non-blank lines; runtime dependency keyring is used (keep).
